content:
Apple One provides multiple popular Apple services bundled together at a discounted price, and in iOS 27, the top-tier Premier plan will get new advantages.

Apple One Premier is getting two upgrades in iOS 27, both related to Apple Intelligence.

If you're an Apple One user needing one more reason to upgrade to Apple One Premier, iOS 27 might just be it.

The new iPhone system software brings two upgrades to the top-tier Apple One bundle.

  • Apple Home AI features
  • Higher image generation usage limits and more

Apple's Home app will gain multiple AI features in iOS 27, some of which will be exclusive to iCloud+ subscribers on the 2TB plan. In other words, you'll need Apple One Premier or the highest standalone iCloud+ plan to access them.

It remains unclear whether all or only some AI features require a subscription. The iOS 27 beta notes only state: 'Apple Intelligence for Home requires an iCloud+ subscription of 2TB or higher.'

However, the upgrades to HomeKit secure video will most likely require at least the top-tier plan, including features like automatic video descriptions, video clip search, and automatic marking of important clips.

If you need a camera that supports HomeKit secure video, I recommend:

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: an affordable option at just US$35
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: supports 4K recording, but is pricier at US$59

Additionally, some new AI features in iOS 27 (such as image generation) have daily usage limits. According to Apple, Apple One Premier subscribers will receive higher usage limits:

The iCloud+ plan included in Apple One's Individual plan does not qualify. So if you want higher AI usage limits, this is another reason to choose Apple One Premier.

Apple One starts at US$19.95 per month and includes Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and more.
